strings.subtitle: — Senyehi sa faele —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ho hula le ho tlohela ha ho fumanehe. Sebelisa konopo e ka tlase.
strings.ft_lnk: Tsela e kgutshwane (.lnk) — e tla hanngoa
strings.shred_button: S E N Y E H A
strings.ssd_warning:
Temoso! Ho SSD, mokhoa wa ho ngola hodimo ha o netefatse ho senyeha ka lebaka la TRIM.
Lenaneo lena ke la HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Faele "{name}" e tla ngolwa hodimo mme e hlakolwe.

Tswela pele?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.error_cannot_read:
Ha e kgone ho bala faele:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  FAELE E NGOTSWE HODIMO E HLAKOTSWE
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS mela ya data e meng (ADS) ha e sebetsoe.
• Koranta ya USN ha e hlatsuoe.
• Dikopi tsa seriti le dibapisi tsa leru
  (OneDrive jj.) ha di amehe.
strings.step_delete: Ho hlakola ho feta moqomo wa matlakala
strings.status_full: Dikahare di ngotswe hodimo ka botlalo ka lefela. Ho kgutlisa ha ho kgonehe — disebediswa di tla bona lefela feela.
strings.status_fast: Hlooho, mohatla le mela ya 4 MB di ngotswe hodimo. Tse ding ha di a ameha, empa ka lebaka la makgohlo, ho kgutlisa ka botlalo ke disebediswa tsa bareki ha ho kgonehe. Bakeng sa ditokomane tsa lekunutu, sebedisa mooki O FELLETSE.
strings.status_empty: Faele e ne e le lefela, ho ngola hodimo ha ho a hlokahala. E hlakotswe.
strings.error_permission: Ha e kgone ho fumana faele. E kanna e butswe lenaneong le leng. E kwale mme o leke hape.
strings.error_not_found: Faele ha e a fumanwa. E kanna e hlakoilwe.
strings.error_is_symlink: Ena ke sehokelo sa letshwao. Dihokelo ha di kgone ho senyeha — faele ya sepheo e tla dula e lokile.
strings.error_reparse: Ena ke faele ya sebaka (OneDrive kapa e tshwanang). Data ya yona e lerung, eseng ho disk — ha ho letho le senyehang mona.
strings.error_not_file: Ena ha se faele (foldara kapa ntho e nngwe). Tlohela faele.
strings.error_hardlinks: Faele ena e na le dihokelo tse ding tse thata ({n} kaofela). Dihokelo tse thata ha di na e ka sehloohong — mabitso ohle a a lekana. Haeba o senya ka tsela ya hajoale, data e tla ngolwa hodimo mme e kgAOLWE ho 32 byte, empa masalla a tla dula a fumaneha ka dihokelo tse ding. Hlakola dihokelo tsohle pele.
strings.error_compressed:
Faele e hatisitswe, e patilwe kapa e sesa. Ho ngola hodimo ka lefela ha ho netefatse ho senyeha ha data ya kgale hobane NTFS e e boloka ka tsela e fapaneng.

Tlosa tshobotsi: tobetsa ka ho le letona → Ditlhopho → Tse tsoetseng pele → tlosa letshwao ho "Hatisa" le/kapa "Pata". Ebe o matha SHREDDER hape.
